notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Scans for WinRM ports 5985 (HTTP) and 5986 (HTTPS). WinRM must be explicitly enabled on older Windows but is on by default from Server 2012. Confirming open WinRM with valid credentials = interactive PowerShell shell via evil-winrm.

=== CHAINING ===
Port 5985/5986 open → attempt evil-winrm with discovered credentials → interactive PS shell → enumerate → privesc.
